top_signals.title: Bain Pushes Back LNG Glut Outlook to 2030 as War Tightens Market
top_signals.summary: A looming global glut of liquefied natural gas has been pushed back by more than a year as the conflict in the Middle East disrupts supplies and delays projects, according to Bain & Co., extending a period of tightness that’s delivering higher profits for traders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Global refinery inputs fell sharply in the second quarter of 2026 before modest recovery
top_signals.summary: Global crude oil refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), or 6%, following the start of conflict in late February in the Middle East, according to data from Kpler. Throughput then increased by 1.8 million b/d in the third quarter, primarily as refiners in the region adjusted to new trade flows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Jane Fraser on IPO Pipeline, AI, & Interest Rate Outlook
top_signals.summary: Jane Fraser, Citi's Chair and CEO, says NVIDIA’s better-than-expected earnings and increased guidance were not the only issues investors were weighing; they were also focused on whether AI-related financing would continue and who would lead the company next. She speaks with Lisa Abramowicz at Bloomberg Newsmakers. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Refineries have shifted production away from gasoline to middle distillates
top_signals.summary: Particularly high refinery margins for distillate fuel oil and jet fuel have contributed to shifts in the refinery yields of major products in 2026. Data from our latest Petroleum Supply Monthly—which includes data through August 2026—indicate refinery yields of gasoline have decreased significantly this year to support increased production of distillate fuel oil and jet fuel, sometimes referred to as middle distillates due to their relative cut points in the oil refining process.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: The share of solar generation with co-located battery storage is increasing
top_signals.summary: Utility-scale solar developers are increasingly co-locating battery storage with new solar photovoltaic capacity. As of September 2026, over 16% of new utility-scale solar capacity added this year is co-located with operable battery storage, compared with 2% in 2017, according to data reported to EIA by operators.

top_signals.title: Mozambique Approves Exxon’s Redesigned $30 Billion Rovuma LNG Plan
top_signals.summary: Mozambique’s Council of Ministers on Tuesday approved ExxonMobil’s (NYSE:XOM) amended development plan for the Rovuma LNG project, clearing a regulatory hurdle before a final investment decision (FID) the company expects by the end of the year. The government said the revised plan lowers development costs through electric natural gas processing modules, O Económico reported. The amended plan raises the onshore plant’s capacity to 18.6 million tonnes per annum (mtpa) of liquefied natural gas (LNG), from the 15.2 mtpa approved…
